opening.argument: The speaker says the video explains how to use a Netflix gift card or redeem code, then directs viewers to the account section to redeem it. The visible card instructions and billing page support that instructional purpose. The separate giveaway invitation, WowApp sign-up statement, and subscribe request are not described as requiring payment or data, promising earnings, or causing loss. Nor is the subscribe request explicitly tied to the gift-card guidance or either promotion.
